Subject: MAP: scope lock, evidence owners, and data residency + DPA redline cadence

Hi Liam / Priya —

Thanks for the time today. As discussed, I captured a minimal mutual action plan to get IronBridge to security acceptance for the initial eval. High level asks and suggested owners below; can you confirm next-week commitments so we can lock calendar slots and kickoff evidence intake?

Proposed MAP milestones (suggested target dates):
- SIG/CAIQ (lite) completed (answers + evidence) — target: 2026-12-15 (owner: IronBridge / procurement + internal evidence)
- DPA signed (final redline accepted) — target: 2026-12-22 (owner: Legal / Procurement)
- SOC 2 evidence readiness (controls mapped; Type II schedule noted) — milestone: evidence intake started by 2026-12-10 (owner: Redwood / evidence owners below)

Questions we need from you to finalize scope:
1) Confirm in-scope product surfaces (API endpoints, embeddings store, and logs for troubleshooting).
2) Residency requirement: do you require EU data residency for any customer subset? (we have options; see attachment).
3) Any mandatory SIG/CAIQ questions we should prioritize?

Attachment: SIG-Lite-Answers-20261201.xlsx (initial template), DPA-redline-v3.docx

Data retention baseline (Redwood default):
- Request logs: 90 days
- Short-term KV/cache: ephemeral per signed TTL
- Transactional metadata for analytics: 13 months (configurable)
If you need strict residency or different retention windows we’ll note that in the MAP and DPA carveouts.

Next steps I’m proposing:
- Priya/Andrew: confirm procurement timeline and who will lead DPA redline follow-ups.
- IronBridge: confirm scope (answer Q1-3 above) by EOD Friday so Marcus & team can prepare evidence checklist.
- Redwood: Marcus & Naomi will own evidence intake and schedule the weekly sync starting 2026-12-03.

Thanks — I’ll circulate a one-page MAP after we get your confirmations.

Best,
Chloe Martin

Appreciate the quick turn, Liam. Confirming: we will add an "EU tenancy option" appendix to the MAP. Short summary below that I'll add to the MAP doc (and attach the one-pager):

Residency options (summary):
- Default (hosted): data processed in US regions; logs retained in US.
- EU-Residency Add-on: customer data (specified datasets) routed to EU-only tenancy; additional cost and provisioning lead time ~6 weeks.
- On-prem / VPC Private: for regulated customers; multi-week installation and onboarding.

Acceptance criteria we'll use in MAP (draft):
- SIG/CAIQ: all critical/important questions answered and evidence linked in Drive by 2026-12-15.
- DPA: Redwood to respond to redline within 48h of receipt; target final execution by 2026-12-22.
- SOC 2: controls mapping completed and evidence intake started by 2026-12-10. SOC 2 Type II audit scheduling is a separate track; acceptance for the pilot will focus on control evidence and SIWE (service implementation) checks.

I've attached Residency-options-summary.pdf and will circulate an updated MAP with the appendix by EOD 12/03. Marcus / Naomi — see below for ownership asks.
